name: @ship/deck-hono
description: Deck transport adaptor for Hono / Bun — the TypeScript sibling of deck-axum. Serves a `deck build` SPA output (index.html + hashed assets), the /_deck/* framework singletons, and the live-data SSE / data port, mirroring deck-core's DeckResponse serve contract byte-for-byte. The serve core is framework-agnostic (Request -> Response); the Hono binding is a thin layer.
